name.basis: The firm's own name on its site and on its adviser's Form ADV (Bain Capital Ventures, LP, CRD 145652).

website.basis: The firm's site (Next.js over a public Sanity CMS: portfolio at /portfolio/, posts at /insight/, team at /team/); Bain Capital Crypto's list lives at baincapitalcrypto.com.

founding_year.basis: The firm's own 2006 page: 'In 2001, we formed Bain Capital Ventures as a separate arm of Bain Capital'; its 2018 post (the $1B raise) looks back to 2001 (https://baincapitalventures.com/insight/1-billion-to-fuel-the-next-generation-of-innovators/); Wikipedia's infobox gives 2001. A venture vehicle, Bain Capital Venture Fund, L.P., held Recruitsoft from November 1999 (Taleo's S-1), before the arm's formal founding (decisions.md D2).

history.value: Bain Capital Ventures was founded in Boston in 2001 as the venture arm of Bain Capital, which had backed young companies since the 1980s. It became known for bets on LinkedIn, DocuSign, Rubrik, Redis and Attentive, and it manages about $10 billion after raising $1.6 billion for its eleventh fund in 2026. The track record on this page covers its minority venture stakes; companies bought outright and Bain Capital's earlier deals are left out.
history.basis: Founding (2001, Boston, the venture arm of Bain Capital, founded 1984; Bain Capital's early-stage investing 'dates back to 1984' per the firm's 2006 page, https://web.archive.org/web/20060615151520/http://www.baincapitalventures.com:80/portfolio/index.asp?viewType=All&Section=3,0,0). Bets: LinkedIn and DocuSign (the firm's 2019 post lists them among its IPOs), Rubrik (Series E, 2019, the firm's post), Redis (Series A, 2013, Wikipedia), Attentive (Series A, 2018, the firm's post); all are members on this page. Assets: $9,837,931,000 regulatory assets under management, Form ADV of 2026-03-31 (CRD 145652, Item 5.F), 'about $10 billion' (Wikipedia). Fund XI: 'We've raised $1.6B for BCV Fund XI' (the firm's homepage, read 2026-09-27; Business Wire 2026-09-16). BOUNDARY (moved from the page): Bain Capital's generalist-fund deals of 1984-1998 that the firm's 2006 page listed (Staples, Bright Horizons, DoubleClick) are out under decisions.md R1, and control positions (SolarWinds, SurveyMonkey, Zelis, Air Medical, iPay, M/C Communications and others) are out under D4; Bain Capital Crypto is the same adviser and is in.

investment_concept.basis: The firm's own statement, read off the homepage on 2026-09-27: the hero headline reads 'Capital's duty to the future.' (the page's H1). Competing line on the same page: the meta description 'Bain Capital Ventures helps founders build iconic businesses that transform the way we live and work.' Published inside quotation marks, as the firm's own words (Erik, 2026-09-26).

investment_stage.basis: The firm's own stage tags on its portfolio (Seed, Early, Growth; decisions.md R2) and its 2023 release ('support of technology startups from seed to growth', https://baincapitalventures.com/insight/bcv-launches-new-fund-x-select-iv-funds/). The landed entry distribution over the members is Seed 111, Series A 84, Growth 102, Pre-Seed 2 (restated in report.md).

investment_geo.basis: From the members' headquarters at the rebuild of 2026-09-27: US 377 of 417, Europe 16 (UK 6, France 3, Germany 3, Denmark, Sweden, Switzerland, Czechia), Canada 8, Israel 5, India 3, one each in Mexico, China, Australia. The firm's offices are Boston (principal), New York and San Francisco (Form ADV). Core US, other Europe and Canada (two-label cap).

investment_range.basis: MEDIAN: $15.3M, the median entry round over the 122 members whose entry Form D is on EDGAR (the round that filing belongs to; p10 $3.0M, p25 $6.0M, p75 $34.5M, p90 $76.3M), published as $15M. LOWER and UPPER: the p10 and p90 of the same distribution, since the firm publishes no cheque range. It is a round size, not a cheque size, and Form D coverage starts in 2009. Aggregator 'typical check' figures were not used.

notable_investments.basis: The five best known of the firm's own companies, most recognised first (PRO-152, Erik 2026-09-24). Considered next: Attentive, Moveworks, Kiva Systems, Jet.com, Poolside.

aum.basis: Both ends: the sworn regulatory assets under management of Bain Capital Ventures, LP (CRD 145652, SEC 801-69071), Item 5.F of the Form ADV annual amendment of 2026-03-31: $9,837,931,000 (sources/registers/adv-145652.pdf). Section 7.B lists 20 private funds, venture and crypto. Wikipedia: 'slightly over $10 billion of investor capital since 2001'. The $1.6B Fund XI (September 2026) postdates the ADV.

funds.basis: Core and co-investment funds from Wikipedia's fund table (inception through 2023) and the firm's own releases: Fund XI $1.6B (homepage and Business Wire, 2026-09-16); Fund X $1.44B and Select IV $480M, '$1.9 billion' together (https://baincapitalventures.com/insight/bcv-launches-new-fund-x-select-iv-funds/); Fund 2021 $950M and Coinvestment III $350M, 'our ninth core fund ... $1.3 billion' (https://baincapitalventures.com/insight/announcing-bcv-fund-2021/); Fund 2019 $650M and Coinvestment II $250M, the '$1 billion in new funds' of November 2018 (https://baincapitalventures.com/insight/1-billion-to-fuel-the-next-generation-of-innovators/; the vehicles' Form Ds file $650M and $250M); Fund 2016 $600M, Fund 2014 $650M and the Coinvestment Fund $200M (Form D totals); Fund 2012 $660M (Wikipedia; the vehicle's Form D sold $600.6M, its private-investor feeder $6.55M); 2009 $525M, 2007 $500M, 2005 $250M, 2001 $250M (Wikipedia). Bain Capital Crypto's funds (Crypto I, 2021; Crypto II, 2024) are on the adviser's Form ADV but no size was read, so they are not listed. No entry carries an accession, so none is validated against a filing.

hq_location.basis: Principal office on the newest Form ADV: 200 Clarendon Street, Boston, MA (BAIN CAPITAL VENTURES, LP, CRD 145652, Annual Amendment filed 2026-03-31). The firm's site lists Boston, MA; New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Palo Alto, CA; the principal office is among them, so the site agrees. Rule (Erik 2026-09-24): the newest Form ADV principal office, unless the firm's own site disagrees, and then the site wins.
